meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 它会清理分支改动或你指定文件里的 AI 代码异味：先用回归测试锁定现有行为，再分类多轮删改，最后跑测试、lint 和类型检查验证，不通过就回退。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop 或去除近期改动里的 AI 代码异味时触发；不带参数时默认作用于整个分支相对 main 的 diff。

say.text: 清理当前分支相对 main 的改动，先补回归测试再删异味
say.note: 先锁定行为，再按类别多轮清理

say.text: 只清理 src/foo.py，删掉无用注释和死代码
say.note: 限定范围到这一个文件

say.text: 把超过 250 行的 src/bar.py 拆成模块
say.note: 会先给出拆分方案再执行

howto.what_en: It cleans AI-generated code smells from your branch diff or a given file list: it locks current behavior with regression tests, runs multi-pass cleanup, then verifies with tests, lint and typecheck, reverting when verification fails.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes; with no arguments it defaults to the branch diff against main.

say_en.text: Clean up the current branch's changes vs main; add regression tests first
Only clean src/foo.py: drop obvious comments and dead code

say_en.note: Shows a split plan before executing
